env.masking.body: A Secret value is kept in the plaintext vault next to the database on this computer (file mode 0600) and never comes back to this window; to change it, replace it. It shows as dots in the table, the Trace, the console, flow results, History and copied cURL. Values you type into an Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie or X-Api-Key header are masked by header name too. Reference any variable as {reference}.
